title: Wildly Spicy Brazilian Fish Ceviche
description: A rich and juicy Brazilian dish featuring sashimi-cut fish, chilli, and anti-inflammatory friendly ingredients, perfect for a quick fix meal.
instructions: Cut the cod fillets into small sashimi-cut pieces and place them in a large bowl.
In a blender or food processor, combine lime juice, mixed bell peppers, red onion, cilantro, malagueta peppers, and garlic, and blend until smooth.
Pour the blended mixture over the fish pieces and toss to coat.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the fish to marinate.
Just before serving, give the mixture a good stir and adjust the seasoning if needed.
Serve the ceviche chilled, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
